versions.changelog: reactions rule, close-the-loop, reply-to rules; skill-master analytics hook; skill-analytics added

Initial release of the spawn-subagent skill.

- Enables spawning isolated subagents for long-running, complex, or blocking tasks without stalling the main session.
- Includes guidance on when to spawn subagents vs. using the main session.
- Provides clear patterns, code examples, and anti-patterns for efficient task delegation and error handling.
- Documents best practices for writing precise task descriptions and managing parallelism.
- Offers cost-saving tips for running batch or resource-intensive operations.
